_note: push/441: Nightfall (Night's Testament clone) and Dawnbringer (Aetherion clone), crafted from their base sword + 10 boss shards; 12 token-locked skins (7 + 5), one tradeable token each. Everything is created hidden; boss loot wiring and unhide come later. Run push/442 (token binds) from this run's results. Generated by push/dusk_dawn_variants.gen.py; do not hand-edit.

data.name: Umbral Shard
data.description: A shard torn from the boss's core. 10 of them and a Night's Testament craft Nightfall.

data.name: Nightfall
data.description:
Night's Testament, reforged around a core of boss-torn shadow.

Fights exactly as Night's Testament does. What it gains is a wardrobe: seven Nightfall skins, each unlocked by its own token.
Crafted from: Night's Testament and 10 Umbral Shards. The Night's Testament is consumed, even if it is equipped, and its imbuement goes with it.
data.battleDescription: %user holds a blade as dark as night. With one swift movement, too quick for the naked eye, the blade pierces through %target.
